title: Tech Reborn: Yappadium
description: A Tech Reborn based Modpack with alot of Performance upgrades!
body:
A Tech Reborn based Modpack with alot of Performance upgrades!
If you have seen Yappadium itself you know it is a good performance modpack, i used Yappadium for the base of this modpack

Mods included:
- Tech Reborn (And addons!)
- QoL Mods

Important message:

Do not Update Nvidium (Neoforge) and JEI, this will crash you're game.

Only updating this modpack when Tech Reborn is updated to newer versions of Minecraft OR Create itself!
